message.content:
Desserts don’t have a single “official” color—each one can look very different depending on its ingredients and presentation. For example:

| Dessert | Typical Color(s) |
|---------|------------------|
| Chocolate cake | Dark brown (sometimes with chocolate chips or frosting) |
| Strawberry shortcake | Pinkish‑red (from strawberries) |
| Lemon meringue pie | Yellow (lemon filling) with white meringue |
| Fruit tart | Varies: red berries, green kiwi, orange segments, etc. |
| Ice cream | Depends on flavor: vanilla (white), mint (green), strawberry (pink), chocolate (brown) |

So the answer really depends on which dessert you’re thinking of!
